name: player_compose_aim_basis_world_matrix
description: Player::ComposeAimBasisWorldMatrix composes the gun, turret, and cached gun-fire transform rotation into an aim-basis world matrix and copies aimBasisOrigin into the output translation.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly/HLIL inspection in the current session verified the two gwObject3DGetMatrixPtr calls, 12-float matrix copies, yaw-only turret/gunFireTransform rotation product, gun pitch terms, and final copy of playerState->aimBasisOrigin into outMatrix34 translation.
The native smoke checks the composed matrix against a nontrivial gun matrix, turret matrix, cached gunFireTransform, and aimBasisOrigin.
The original body uses x87 operand-cache scheduling; no VC object-byte manifest covers 0x43afd0 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to the player aim/source-cluster pass.
